mapper.sql: c.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.code_review_status<>'REVIEW_REQUIRED' AND NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_code_refs r LEFT JOIN code_chunks current_chunk ON current_chunk.repo_id=r.repo_id AND current_chunk.file_path=r.file_path AND current_chunk.start_line=r.start_line AND current_chunk.content_hash=r.content_hash WHERE r.card_id=c.id AND r.revision=c.revision AND current_chunk.id IS NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT ,0.0 lexical_score, GREATEST(0.0,1-(e.embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector))) semantic_score FROM chunk_embeddings e JOIN code_chunks c ON c.id=e.chunk_id WHERE c.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND e.model=#{model} AND e.content_hash=c.content_hash ORDER BY e.embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector),c.file_path,c.start_line NULLS FIRST LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ,0.0 lexical_score, GREATEST(0.0,1-(e.embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector))) semantic_score FROM knowledge_card_embeddings e JOIN knowledge_cards c ON c.id=e.card_id AND c.revision=e.revision WHERE AND e.model=#{model} ORDER BY e.embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector),c.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO qa_conversations( id,repo_id,account_id,client_request_id,title,question,answer,snapshot_id, provider,evidence_status,fallback_reason,answer_payload ) VALUES( #{id},#{repositoryId},#{accountId},#{clientRequestId},#{title},#{question},#{answer},#{snapshotId}, #{provider},#{evidenceStatus},#{fallbackReason},CAST(#{answerPayload} AS jsonb) )
mapper.select: SELECT id,repo_id,account_id,title,question,answer,snapshot_id,provider,evidence_status, fallback_reason,answer_payload,created_at,updated_at FROM qa_conversations WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND account_id=#{accountId} AND client_request_id=#{clientRequestId}

SELECT c.id,c.repo_id,c.account_id,c.title,c.question,c.answer,c.snapshot_id,c.provider,c.evidence_status, c.fallback_reason,c.answer_payload,c.created_at,c.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qa_citations q WHERE q.conversation_id=c.id) citation_count FROM qa_conversations c WHERE c.id=#{id} AND c.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND c.account_id=#{accountId}
mapper.update: UPDATE qa_conversations SET title=#{title},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND account_id=#{accountId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM qa_conversations WHERE id=#{id} AND repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND account_id=#{accountId}
mapper.select: SELECT source_symbol,target_symbol,relation FROM code_graph_edges WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} LIMIT 500
SELECT id,snapshot_id,symbol_name,content FROM code_chunks WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND symbol_name IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO code_graph_edges(id,repo_id,snapshot_id,source_chunk_id,target_chunk_id,source_symbol,target_symbol,relation) VALUES(#{id},#{repositoryId},#{snapshotId},#{sourceChunkId},#{targetChunkId},#{sourceSymbol},#{targetSymbol},'CALLS') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id,repo_id,title,card_type,content,tags,status,revision,created_at,updated_at, verified_commit,code_review_status,code_reviewed_at FROM knowledge_cards WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND status='PUBLISHED' ORDER BY updated_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_cards SET title=#{title},card_type=#{cardType},content=#{content}, tags=#{tags,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.ArrayTypeHandler},status=#{status}, revision=revision+1,updated_by=#{actorId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND repo_id=#{repositoryId}
mapper.select: SELECT id,snapshot_id,file_path,symbol_name,start_line,end_line,content,content_hash FROM code_chunks WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND id=#{chunkId}

SELECT COALESCE(c.id,r.chunk_id) chunk_id,COALESCE(c.snapshot_id,r.snapshot_id) snapshot_id, r.file_path,COALESCE(c.symbol_name,r.symbol_name) symbol_name,r.start_line,r.end_line,r.content_hash, (c.id IS NULL) stale FROM knowledge_code_refs r LEFT JOIN code_chunks c ON c.repo_id=r.repo_id AND c.file_path=r.file_path AND c.start_line=r.start_line AND c.content_hash=r.content_hash WHERE r.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND r.card_id=#{cardId} AND r.revision=#{revision} ORDER BY r.position
SELECT setting_key,CASE WHEN sensitive THEN '******' ELSE setting_value END value FROM system_settings ORDER BY setting_key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_settings(setting_key,setting_value,updated_by) VALUES(#{key},#{value},#{actorId}) ON CONFLICT(setting_key) DO UPDATE SET setting_value=EXCLUDED.setting_value, updated_by=EXCLUDED.updated_by,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.revision,CONCAT(c.title,E'\n',c.content,E'\n',ARRAY_TO_STRING(c.tags,' ')) content FROM knowledge_cards c LEFT JOIN knowledge_card_embeddings e ON e.card_id=c.id WHERE AND(e.card_id IS NULL OR e.revision<>c.revision OR e.model<>#{model})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_card_embeddings(card_id,repo_id,revision,model,embedding,content_hash) VALUES(#{cardId},#{repositoryId},#{revision},#{model},CAST(#{vector} AS vector),#{contentHash}) ON CONFLICT(card_id) DO UPDATE SET revision=EXCLUDED.revision,embedding=EXCLUDED.embedding, model=EXCLUDED.model,content_hash=EXCLUDED.content_hash,created_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.content,c.content_hash FROM code_chunks c LEFT JOIN chunk_embeddings e ON e.chunk_id=c.id WHERE c.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND(e.chunk_id IS NULL OR e.content_hash<>c.content_hash OR e.model<>#{model})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chunk_embeddings(chunk_id,repo_id,model,dimension,embedding,content_hash) VALUES(#{chunkId},#{repositoryId},#{model},64,CAST(#{vector} AS vector),#{contentHash}) ON CONFLICT(chunk_id) DO UPDATE SET model=EXCLUDED.model,embedding=EXCLUDED.embedding, content_hash=EXCLUDED.content_hash,created_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
